semantic_model.name: sa_insights
semantic_model.description: South African macroeconomic indicators with forecasting. One fact dataset per indicator over monthly, quarterly or annual time dimensions, sourced from the World Bank, IMF and FRED.

ai_context.instructions: Use this model for questions about the South African economy: growth, inflation, employment, interest rates, the rand, trade and the fiscal position. Each fact dataset holds one indicator. Join to the matching dim_date_* dataset on period for calendar attributes. Values are published statistics, not real-time market data; check the observation coverage before drawing conclusions.
examples: What is South Africa's inflation rate?
How has the rand moved against the dollar?
Compare GDP growth and unemployment over the last decade
Is the repo rate restrictive in real terms?
